problems.completion:
let mut v: Vec<u8> = numbers
        .split_whitespace()
        .map(|s| match s {
            "zero" => 0,
            "one" => 1,
            "two" => 2,
            "three" => 3,
            "four" => 4,
            "five" => 5,
            "six" => 6,
            "seven" => 7,
            "eight" => 8,
            "nine" => 9,
            _ => panic!("Invalid number word: {}", s),
        })
        .collect();
    v.sort();
    v.iter()
        .map(|&n| match n {
            0 => "zero",
            1 => "one",
            2 => "two",
            3 => "three",
            4 => "four",
            5 => "five",
            6 => "six",
            7 => "seven",
            8 => "eight",
            9 => "nine",
            _ => unreachable!(),
        })
        .collect::<Vec<_>>()
        .join(" ")
